# CycloneDX schema fixtures

Unmodified upstream schemas retrieved from the CycloneDX specification tags:

- https://github.com/CycloneDX/specification/blob/1.6/schema/bom-1.6.schema.json (2026-10-27)
- https://github.com/CycloneDX/specification/blob/1.5/schema/bom-1.5.schema.json (2026-10-29)
- https://github.com/CycloneDX/specification/blob/1.6/schema/spdx.schema.json
- https://github.com/CycloneDX/specification/blob/1.6/schema/jsf-0.82.schema.json

`vex-findings.json` is an Evergreen scan-findings fixture used to produce a CycloneDX 1.5 VEX document in tests.

CycloneDX schemas are licensed under Apache-2.0; see the upstream
[LICENSE](https://github.com/CycloneDX/specification/blob/1.6/LICENSE).
The dependent schemas are included so validation remains offline.
